_comment: Template for the NAS tenant binding migration (fill subjects/scopes with
real group names and namespaces, then run apply-tenant-bindings.sh).
Run AFTER the new image has booted once (default-deny migration executes at
startup), and AFTER taking a PostgreSQL backup: pg_dump via deploy/backup.sh.
Permissions refer to the RBAC engine: read, push, comment, submit, abandon,
editAccess, editTopicName, addReviewer, createProject, admin, plus labels
Scope '*' is global; 'ns/*' matches a namespace tree; 'label:key=value' matches labeled projects.
